what: cross-fold statistic that survives conformational breathing

arm_B_is_a_no_op.why: Betti curves are ALREADY scale-parameterised by the epsilon grid. betti_curves(D, EPS*median) counts the same feature set as betti_curves(D/median, EPS), so ARM B is an exact duplicate of ARM A. Measured: every ARM-A statistic equals ARM B to the printed precision.
arm_B_is_a_no_op.consequence: Scale normalisation applied to Betti CURVES is vacuous. A genuinely scale-invariant treatment must act on the DIAGRAM (birth,death) pairs, which is what ARM C does via the landscape.

scale_hypothesis.hypothesis: 2K39 is disperse (cited rmsd 3.29 A) so its filtration scale inflates.
scale_hypothesis.verdict: FALSIFIED_ON_THIS_TRUNCATION: the two ensembles have essentially the SAME median CA distance, so the fold difference is NOT a global scale effect.
scale_hypothesis.limit: 2K39 truncated to 10 of 116 models; the full ensemble is more disperse.

two_statistics: The inherited bar 0.8000 is defined on the EXTREMUM ratio (max_within/min_cross), an order statistic. The MEAN ratio answers a different question. On ARM C the extremum ratio is 0.922 (fail) while the mean ratio clears 0.8 comfortably, and the effect size z and the permutation null both show real separation. Both are reported; NEITHER bar is moved, and the extremum verdict stays FAIL because that is the bar that was set.
mechanism: scale normalisation removes the global breathing scale; what remains is diagram SHAPE, which separates folds only if the folds differ in shape
limits: two ensembles only; the permutation null mixes the same pool, so it tests label exchangeability, not generalisation to unseen proteins
MAX_MODELS = 10 per ensemble; the cited rmsd 3.29 A is for the FULL 2K39 ensemble
landscape uses k_max = 3 and a 24-point grid on [0,1]; refinement could move ARM C
median normalisation is a choice; dividing by max is reported in the receipt
